items.title: 如何拆解 MVP 范围，让开发者能估算工期
items.title_orig: How to scope an MVP so a developer can estimate it
items.summary: 先写清要验证的一个问题和一类用户，梳理唯一核心流程，其余想法按四类优先级归档。
items.summary_orig: Originally published on shipfastdev.com . To scope an MVP, write down the one problem you are testing and the one user who has it, map the single flow that takes that user from arrival to the moment they get value, and put every other idea into Must, Should, Could or Won't have. Then write each Must-have as a short user story with acceptance criteria.

items.title: 通俗解释页表：CPU 如何把虚拟地址翻译为物理地址
items.title_orig: Page tables in plain words
items.summary: 页表不是代码，而是内核写入、硬件每次内存访问都要读取的内存中的表，用于地址翻译。
items.summary_orig: Page tables in plain words A program never touches real memory addresses. It uses virtual addresses, and the CPU translates each one to a physical address before the access happens. Page tables are the data the CPU reads to do that translation. They are not code. They are tables in memory, written by the kernel, read by the hardware on every access.

items.title: 为什么衰老的恒星的光度突然下降
items.title_orig: Why Aging Stars Suffer A Sudden Luminosity Dip
items.summary: 当像太阳这样的低质量恒星老化时，它们会离开主序并跟随红巨星分支。当它们上升到这个分支时，它们的亮度稳步增加。但路径中存在一种称为 RGB 亮度凹凸的小问题，它们的亮度会突然下降。
items.summary_orig: When low-mass stars like our Sun age, they leave the main sequence and follow the Red Giant Branch. As they ascend this branch, their luminosity steadily increases. But there's a sort of hiccup in the path called the RGB luminosity bump, where their luminosity suddenly dips.

items.summary: 美国宇航局尼尔·盖雷尔斯·斯威夫特天文台周三在印度尼西亚西部上空坠落回地球大气层，结束了伽马射线爆发猎人在轨道上近22年的营救尝试失败。
items.summary_orig: NASA’s Neil Gehrels Swift Observatory plummeted back into Earth’s atmosphere Wednesday over western Indonesia, ending nearly 22 years in orbit for the gamma-ray burst hunter after a failed attempt to rescue it.
